en: A monochrome postcard showing a rural Alpine village with stone and wooden houses on a hillside, a small church with a bell tower in the middle distance, and high mountains rising in the background. In the foreground, a man in traditional rural clothing stands by a wooden fence, apparently working in the fields. Printed text at the top identifies the Dolomites and the specific locality.
